main.description: A corpus: a curated collection of expressions.

description.description: Free-text description of the corpus: its contents, provenance, and intended use.

version.description: Version identifier for this release of the corpus.

domainUri.description: AT-URI of the domain definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

licensing.description: Licensing terms governing this corpus (supports dual/multi/component licensing).

eprintRefs.description: Eprint records (papers/preprints) describing or associated with this corpus.

knowledgeRefs.description: Knowledge graph references grounding this corpus (e.g., source catalog identifiers, dataset registries such as ldc or elra, associated publications).

reproducibility.description: How this corpus was produced (code, commit, command, environment, seed).

expressionCount.description: Number of expressions in the corpus.

annotationDesign.description: Annotation project design: annotator assignment, adjudication, and quality criteria.

features.description: Open-ended features for this corpus (e.g., genre breakdown, collection method, custom metadata).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this corpus record was created.

languages.description: BCP-47 language tags this record covers. Empty when language is unspecified or unknown.

languageRefs.description: Structured language references for this record, grounding each language via glottolog, iso639-3, or cldr and carrying script, region, variety, and role. Richer companion to the languages tag array.
